# PiTTy v0.6.8 — clearer statistics, working dialogs, a README that helps

## Statistics

- The Timing section shows two numbers for the selected model: the median turn time and the median tool-call time.
- It stays hidden until the selected model actually produces a request, so switching models never leaves the previous model's numbers on screen.

## Dialogs

- The Ctrl+P model picker now moves one row at a time from the highlighted model; Enter selects the highlighted model even from the search box.
- Streaming thinking no longer re-renders the full Markdown block on every delta (throttled to ~10/s, skipped while collapsed), removing lag and flicker.

## README and screenshots

- The README was rewritten around what you actually need: what PiTTy is, how it differs from Pi's built-in TUI, installation, and first steps.
- Screenshots are captured at 140x44 cells (1400x1028) in the same monospace font Konsole uses — a larger terminal without overly large text.

## Reliability

- The native screenshot harness retries transient X11 startup races and cleans up its own state, making repeated capture runs dependable.

## Verification

- Full browser-conditioned suite: 410 passed, 1 skipped; typecheck, native screenshot generation, and `git diff --check` passed.
